SwimmermSimonSeenText:
You have to warm
up before going into the water.

That's basic.
SwimmermSimonAfterBattleText:
CIANWOOD CITY is
a good distance away from here.
SwimmermRandallSeenText:
Hey, you're young
and fit!

Don't ride your
#MON! Swim!
SwimmermRandallAfterBattleText:
Swimming exercises
your entire body. It's healthy.
SwimmerfElaineSeenText:
Are you going to
CIANWOOD?

How about a quick
battle first?
SwimmerfElaineAfterBattleText:
I'd say I'm a bet-
ter swimmer than you. Yeah!
SwimmerfPaulaSeenText:
No inner tube for
me.

I'm hanging on to
a sea #MON!
SwimmerfPaulaAfterBattleText:
While I float like
this, the waves carry me along.
Route40Lass1Text:
Although you can't
see it from here,

CIANWOOD is across
the sea.
Route40PokefanMText:
Hm! There's a big
building up ahead!

What is it?
Route40PokefanMText_Mobile:
Hm! Look at all
those serious- looking trainers streaming in.

What? What?
Route40Lass2Text:
I came to OLIVINE
by ship to see the

sights and soak up
the atmosphere.

Being a port, it
feels so different from a big city.
Route40StandingYoungsterText:
Have you gone to
the BATTLE TOWER?

I think a lot of
tough trainers

have gathered
there already.

But since you have
so many BADGES,

you shouldn't do
badly at all.
MeetMonicaText:
MONICA: Glad to
meet you. I'm

MONICA of Monday.
MonicaGivesGiftText:
As a token of our
friendship, I have a gift for you!
MonicaGaveGiftText:
MONICA: It's an
item that raises

the power of fly-
ing-type moves.

You should equip a
bird #MON with that item.
MonicaMondayText:
MONICA: My broth-
ers and sisters

are all over the
place.

See if you could
find them all!
MonicaNotMondayText:
MONICA: I don't
think today is Monday. How sad…
